heading: Codes in the guides
body:
Codes that start with `TY1` come from the compiler, before your app runs. Codes that start with `TY2` come from the server or from the runtime of a language.

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TY1008` | The project has a `yon.html` file. Yon answers with data, and it never renders HTML. | Models and JSON answers |
| `TY1010` | No language of a service supports the target that you build. | Choosing a service language |
| `TY1303` | The server cannot start. One cause is the topic log folder: `topics.directory` has `..`, is inside `.tachyon`, passes through a symbolic link, or cannot be opened or created. | Topics |
| `TY1307` | A view contains a doctype, `<html>`, `<head>` or `<body>`. Tachyon writes these parts itself. | Templates |
| `TY1308` | A realm or a language does not accept this annotation, or the annotation has a new name, such as `@Component`, which is now `@Helper`. | Annotations A–Z |
| `TY1310` | A role file breaks the folder or file-name rules, or sits in a folder with a new name, such as `delegates`, which is now `helpers`. | Project folders and roles |
| `TY1311` | A view reads a file in `client/shared/data` that does not exist. | Templates |
| `TY1312` | The class that a gateway calls is missing, is outside `server/`, or is in the language of the caller. | Relays and gateways |
| `TY1313` | A plain attribute has a value in braces, such as `title="{name}"`. Braces work only in text. Write `:title="name"` instead. | Templates |
| `TY1314` | A public method of a service or a controller holds a decision, a loop or `try`, or a private method holds more than one decision or loop. Move the code into private methods. | Cohesive services |
| `TY1315` | A block of code repeats: at least 100 tokens over 10 lines, even with other names or values. Move it into a static method of a utility class. | Utilities |
| `TY1316` | A utility class holds a field, a stored value or a method that is not static. | Utilities |
| `TY1317` | Tac code in Rust, Go, C#, Kotlin, Dart or Ruby calls the browser directly, for example with Go's `syscall/js`, or a service that is linked into a native app uses one of Tachyon's browser APIs or built-in event models, such as `Clipboard` or `ConnectivityChanged`. Put the browser work in a JavaScript, TypeScript or WebAssembly service and send the result with an event. | Rust, Go and C# in the browser |
| `TY1318` | A class file does not have the name of its class, for example `Order.ts` that declares `Invoice`, or a models file holds more than one model. Rename the file or the class so that both have the same spelling, and put each model in its own file. | Project folders and roles |
| `TY1320` | `ty` changed on disk. The preview restarts with the new `ty`, or keeps the old server when the new `ty` refuses the project, and says why. | Preview and build |
| `TY1322` | A route does not say who may call it, or `@Allow` names a role that has no type in `server/roles/`. Write `@Public`, `@SignedIn` or `@Allow(Role)`. | Who may call a route |
| `TY1323` | A `@SignedIn` or `@Allow` route has no `@IdentityProvider` class to say who is signed in, or the project has two of them. | Who may call a route |
| `TY1324` | The code, a template or public settings hold what looks like a password, a token or a key. Put it in `.env` with a `YON_` name. | Isolation and security |
| `TY1325` | Code runs a text as code (`eval` and similar calls), or joins values into query text instead of passing them as parameters. | Isolation and security |
| `TY1326` | Code sends a request to a host that `tac.outgoing.hosts` or `outgoing.hosts` does not list. | Isolation and security |
| `TY1327` | Classes need each other in a loop, a class needs a class of a higher layer, or a class needs a controller. The message names the whole loop. | Dependencies point down |
| `TY1328` | A class, method, field or parameter name has a word that is not English, such as `usr` or `cfg`. The help gives the whole word. | Plain-English names |
| `TY1329` | A method takes more than 4 parameters, or a class needs more than 5 other classes. | Small signatures |
| `TY1330` | A text or number is written twice or more in a class, or a number is in a condition, without a name. Give it a class constant. | Named values |
| `TY1333` | A public method or field of a service, helper, controller or utility is used by nothing outside its class: no view, no other class and no annotation. Make it private in the form of your language. | Public only when used |
| `TY1334` | A Groovy field or method is declared with `def`. Tachyon reads member types to check routes, models and injection. Write the type, such as `String name` or `List<Order> findOrders()`. A local variable inside a method may still use `def`. | Project folders and roles |
| `TY1335` | An F# file has a `module` or `namespace` line, a file-level `let` or `do`, or an attribute on the same line as the type or member it marks. Tachyon places every F# file in one namespace, and each attribute goes on its own line. | Project folders and roles |
| `TY1336` | A view is hard to use with a screen reader or a keyboard: a picture without `alt`, a button, link or field without a name or label, a skipped heading level, a `tabindex` above 0, a wrong `aria-*` attribute, or an `<iframe>` without a title. | Templates |
| `TY1337` | A route loads more script or WebAssembly than `tac.budgets.script` or `tac.budgets.webassembly` allows. The message names the biggest files. | Build and deploy |
| `TY1338` | The API breaks `server/api-baseline.json`: a route, method, model or field is gone, a type is narrower, a value became required, or the status changed, and the major version did not go up. | Build and deploy |
| `TY1356` | A field, parameter or return value of a class has no type, a Ruby type comment names no known class, or a class file switches the type checker off (`@ts-nocheck`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, `# type: ignore`). Write the type comment or native type that the help shows. The check is off until you set `types.check` or `tac.types.check` to `true`. | Types in every language |
| `TY1340`–`TY1355` | A suggestion, not an error: the code has a simpler form that reads more plainly, such as `return a > b;` instead of an `if` that returns `true` or `false`. The build goes on. `ty migrate fix --write` applies the simpler form. | Simpler forms |
| `TY1405` | A component has a `hydrate` value, but its view names no service. Remove `hydrate`, or use a service. | Your first app |
| `TY1331` | A field that Tachyon fills, a `Needs` field or a `NeedsAll` field without a starting value, is declared nullable, for example `label?: string` or `final String? path;`. Tachyon never leaves it null. Write the non-null form, such as `label!: string` or `late final String path;`, or give a field that may stay empty a starting value. `ty migrate fix --write` rewrites the simple cases. | Dependency injection |
| `TY1332` | A field that holds an injected class, a `Needs` field or a Yon `NeedsAll` field, does not use the language's variable case, for example `LedgerStore LedgerStore;` in Java or `ledgerStore: LedgerStore` in Python. Write lowerCamel case (`ledgerStore`) in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Groovy, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, Go and PHP (`$ledgerStore`), snake_case (`ledger_store`) in Python, Ruby and Rust, and an underscore with lowerCamel case (`_ledgerStore`) for a private or internal C# field (`LedgerStore` for a C# property or a public field). Only the case is checked, not the words. `ty migrate fix --write` renames the field and its uses in the class. | Dependency injection |
| `TY1407` | A page does not pass a property that a `NeedsAll` service needs, or it passes a property to a field that the service gets injected instead, such as `documentation` next to `DocumentationService`. Rename the field, or stop passing the property. | Dependency injection |
| `TY1408` | An answer to `ty init` or `ty add` is not in the list, or two answers do not fit together, for example a sockets example in an app without a server. | Install |
| `TY1409` | A tool install did not finish, or a download does not match the SHA-256 that its vendor publishes. Tachyon deletes such a download. | Install |
| `TY1502` | A worker says how often it runs in two places. Use only one. | Annotations A–Z |
| `TY2010` | The firecracker isolation mode does not allow gateways. | Isolation and security |
| `TY2015` | `StreamRoute` is used in a language that cannot stream. | Streams |
| `TY2020` | A test case failed. `ty preview` still starts and shows the failure in its error box, even if every public method was called. | Test units |
| `TY2022` | `ty test --coverage` found a public method of an annotated class that no test case called. | Test units |
| `TY2023` | No test case called a public method of an annotated class, for example `no test case called GreetingService.message`. `ty preview` starts and lists the methods in its error box. | Test units |
| `TY2024` | `ty test` or the automatic tests before `ty preview` cannot write or invalidate the record of called methods in `.tachyon/coverage`. | Test units |
| `TY2112` | A program that a gateway needs is missing when the server starts. | Relays and gateways |
